question: Should OpenClaw accept this UI-only comparative cost-window feature on the Control UI Usage page after the daily-bucket blocker is fixed?
rationale: The implementation avoids new storage/config/protocol surface, but it is a new operator-facing presentation feature tied to a protected maintainer-labeled product issue.

options.title: Accept after bucket fix
options.body: Fix the daily bucket contract, rerun exact-head validation, and land if the refreshed UI-only diff remains equivalent.

options.title: Request UI narrowing
options.body: Keep the PR open but ask for a smaller placement, wording, or coverage adjustment before product acceptance.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Leave the linked issue as backlog if maintainers want a broader Usage dashboard redesign first.

recommendation.title: Accept after bucket fix
recommendation.body: Fix the daily bucket contract, rerun exact-head validation, and land if the refreshed UI-only diff remains equivalent.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle opened the feature request and PR and has the strongest recent Usage cost UI history.
